backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to involved frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing short descriptions of various frontend components and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and OKLCH theme variables for light/dark romantic color scheme.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app and setting meta tags and favicon.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that renders all sections, ambient effects, controls, and theme provider.
frontend/src/components/controls/CopyLin: Button that copies the page URL to clipboard with tooltip and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/controls/Effects: Toggle button that enables or disables ambient floating effects with session persistence.
frontend/src/components/controls/MusicCo: Background music controller with play, mute, and volume settings stored in session storage.
frontend/src/components/controls/Section: Sticky side navigation that highlights and scrolls smoothly to page sections.
frontend/src/components/effects/AmbientE: Renders animated floating heart and petal particles on a canvas, respecting reduced-motion settings and session-based toggle.
frontend/src/components/effects/HeartBur: Creates a short-lived heart-shaped particle burst animation from the screen center using a canvas.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer displaying credit text with animated heart icon.
frontend/src/components/modals/ProposalM: Displays a decorative modal with heart icons and text shown after a proposal confirmation.
frontend/src/components/sections/Gallery: Shows an image carousel with scroll reveal effects and allows users to upload and add validated images to the gallery.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Renders the landing hero section with animated hearts and introductory text.
frontend/src/components/sections/LoveSto: Displays a scroll-revealed timeline of love story items with icons, colors, and descriptive text.
frontend/src/components/sections/Message: Shows a stylized handwritten message section with decorative heart icons and scroll reveal.
frontend/src/components/sections/Proposa: Provides the proposal interaction with YES buttons, triggers a heart burst animation, and opens a proposal modal.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on authentication identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing identity loading, login, logout, and status states.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder export since no backend queries exist.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollReveal.ts: Implements a hook that detects when an element enters the viewport using IntersectionObserver and exposes a visibility flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionStorageStat: Custom hook syncing React state with sessionStorage using JSON serialization.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles, romantic color variables, fonts, and custom glow/animation utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, configuring React Query and the Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme with custom OKLCH-based romantic color palette and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes project metadata, goals, required assets, and implemented romantic website features.
